business_problem: Univé needed to build organization-wide AI capability across insurance operations so employees could safely redesign their own work instead of waiting for centralized software projects or isolated AI pilots.
solution_summary: Univé combines ChatGPT Enterprise, governance-by-design, and employee-led experimentation to build what it calls an AI-ready workforce. Leadership sessions reframed AI from an IT rollout into an organizational capability, while enterprise authentication, inherited connector permissions, privacy assessments, security reviews, and responsible-AI monitoring created the confidence to scale adoption safely. Within that foundation, employees spend hundreds of hours each week redesigning tasks, building approximately 1,500 custom GPTs, and experimenting with Workspace Agents that proactively prepare claims, underwriting, and other recurring work. In pet insurance, a Workspace Agent assembles files, reviews invoices, checks policy conditions, highlights anomalies, and prepares a traceable recommendation before a human claims professional makes the final decision. Underwriters likewise begin the day with pre-structured queues grounded in approved enterprise sources. The result is a cooperative insurer where governance accelerates experimentation and employees become the builders of internal AI capability.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the secure enterprise workspace employees use for day-to-day AI adoption.

solution_components.name: Custom GPTs
solution_components.role: Encode task-specific workflows that employees create to solve internal operational challenges.

solution_components.name: Workspace Agents
solution_components.role: Proactively prepare claims and underwriting work using approved enterprise data sources.

data_flow: Employee prompts and enterprise records flow through ChatGPT Enterprise, custom GPTs, and Workspace Agents under inherited permission controls. Agents prepare evidence-backed claims or underwriting cases before humans review, decide, and feed successful patterns back into new GPTs and workflows.
business_outcome: Univé achieved broad sustained adoption, shifted employees from passive users to active builders, and accelerated insurance operations such as claims preparation and underwriting without removing human accountability.
